mapper.select:
select `inventoryinfo`.*, `saleinfo`.`sale_num` as saleNum, `saleinfo`.`return_pos` as returnPos, `saleinfo`.`return_transport` as returnTransport, `purchaseinfo`.`supply_num` as supplyNum, `purchaseinfo`.`purchase_transport` as purchaseTransport, `druginfo`.`drug_code` as drugCode, `druginfo`.`drug_name` as drugName from `inventoryinfo` left join `saleinfo` on `inventoryinfo`.`saleinfo_id` = `saleinfo`.id left join `purchaseinfo` on `inventoryinfo`.`purchaseinfo_id` = `purchaseinfo`.id left join `druginfo` on `inventoryinfo`.`druginfo_id` = `druginfo`.id
and `druginfo`.`drug_code` like concat ('%', #{drugCode}, '%')
and `druginfo`.`drug_name` like concat ('%', #{drugName}, '%')
and `purchaseinfo`.`purchase_transport` like concat ('%', #{purchaseTransport}, '%')
and `saleinfo`.`return_pos` like concat ('%', #{returnPos}, '%')
and `saleinfo`.`return_transport` like concat ('%', #{returnTransport}, '%')
